business_summary.text: Anant Raj Limited is a Delhi-NCR real estate developer with residential townships, commercial leasing and hospitality, and is building a data centre and cloud services business through Anant Raj Cloud Pvt Ltd (Ashok Cloud).

call_points.text: Targeting 357 MW total IT load capacity by FY2032, with 63 MW expected by the end of FY27.
25% of the 357 MW IT load capacity will be used for cloud services, subject to market demand.
Data centre, infrastructure and allied services revenue was ₹90 Cr in Q1FY27.
EBITDA margin rose 449 bps YoY to 31.15%, with EBITDA including other income.
Infomerics upgraded the company's rating to 'A- Stable' outlook.
GH 3 licence over 6.38 acres with about 1.20 msf saleable area is in advanced stage.
The board approved a demerger into Ashok Cloud Pvt Ltd, with 1 Ashok Cloud share for every 1 Anant Raj share on the record date.
The company was net debt-free as on March 31, 2026.
Anant Raj Cloud Singapore Pte Ltd was commissioned to source clients from South East Asia and the rest of the world.

operating_notes.text: Approved incorporation of Anant Raj Cloud Singapore Pte. Ltd. as a wholly owned subsidiary with initial share capital of SGD 1,000 for data center and cloud services.
Acquired remaining 25% stake in Romano Projects Private Limited for ₹3.58 Cr, making it a wholly owned subsidiary.
Signed MoU with Govt. of Andhra Pradesh for 50 MW IT Load data center.
As of March 31, 2026, ₹350.00 crore of QIP proceeds were utilized out of ₹1,100.00 crore.
Data center operational capacity reached 28 MW IT load across Manesar and Panchkula.
Signed MoU with Haryana Enterprises Promotion Centre (HEPC) to invest approximately ₹25,000 Cr for data center and cloud services.
Data centre IT load was 28 MW operational (21 MW Manesar, 7 MW Panchkula) with 63 MW targeted by end-FY27.
Commercial leasing portfolio is 1.92 msf, fully leased under long-term agreements.
Potential incremental annual rental of ₹210 Cr p.a. from Anant Raj Center 1 and 2 expansions, subject to approvals and completion.
Received RERA registration for luxury residential project 'The Estate One' in Sector 63A, Gurugram, with built-up area potential of 1.22 million square feet.

Out of ₹1,100 Cr QIP proceeds, ₹114.27 Cr has been deployed in data centre subsidiary Anant Raj Cloud, ₹145.27 Cr in land acquisition, ₹125 Cr in debt repayment, ₹19.12 Cr in project construction, and ₹95.87 Cr in general corporate purposes

timeline.summary: Anant Raj clarified to the exchanges that its response is awaited regarding a news report on ED raids.
Anant Raj approved setting up a wholly owned subsidiary, Anant Raj Cloud Singapore Pte. Ltd., in Singapore for data center and cloud services.
Anant Raj approved acquiring the remaining 25% stake in Romano Projects Private Limited for ₹3.58 Cr to make it a wholly owned subsidiary.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹646.81 Cr (+19.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹146.6 Cr (+23.6% YoY).
Anant Raj reported Q4FY26 QIP proceeds utilization of ₹350 Cr out of ₹1,100 Cr with zero deviations.
Anant Raj reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹646.81 Cr and FY26 PAT of ₹557.02 Cr in an investor presentation.
Anant Raj signed an MoU with the Government of Haryana on June 1, 2026, to invest approximately ₹25,000 crore for developing data center and cloud services.
Amit Sarin and PACs declared no encumbrance on Anant Raj Limited shares for FY2026, holding 57.42% as of March 31, 2026.

On 11 August 2026, Anant Raj's investor presentation showed Q1FY27 revenue of ₹631.40 Cr (+6.58% YoY), EBITDA margin of 31.15%, 28 MW of data centre IT load operational and a board-approved demerger into Ashok Cloud Pvt Ltd.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹661.53 Cr (+4.9% YoY), net profit ₹156.49 Cr (+13.3% YoY) (Q1FY27 includes ₹3.06 Cr from discontinued operations).
Anant Raj submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for Q2FY27 showing ₹526.52 Cr deployed out of ₹1,100 Cr gross QIP proceeds.
Anant Raj released its investor presentation for Q2 and H1 FY27, highlighting progress in its real estate and data centre expansion.
